The prerequisite FAILS, so the30 original-USD jobs are not run as requested. No P/Phi/Gamma inference or default promotion.

All initial mirrors, actual phases and saved pose/yaw consistency passed. Independent verification covers all120 cell metrics,60 paired command cells, raw S/D and half-swap arrays and all3125 five-seed bootstrap resamples. It detected float32 accumulation in common-prefix summaries; only that derived calculation was promoted to float64. All1110 formal raw inputs, S20/D20, half-swap intervals and every gate decision are unchanged, with source/hash correction evidence retained. Verifier tolerances were not relaxed.

The one next recommendation is investigation of simulator equivariance, including contact/cooking order and finite-precision state/clock/tensor effects; this result alone does not identify a sole cause. No further experiments or training in this issue. Four plots have been visually reviewed; exact-state colored front/side/paired-overhead media QA and final archive/commit/push remain in progress.
